families.rationale: The 128-case matrix is already compact and protects distinct arithmetic and preservation boundaries. Keep it rather than force a rewrite for a small line-count gain; prioritize shared harness ownership and large replay matrices. CPU-only relocation remains separate from this retention decision.

families.basis: TI register ADD/SUB/LD, signed 40-bit shift, saturation, carry and sticky-overflow contracts. The existing independent bit-position and integer arithmetic references remain unchanged. Exact staged publication and producer timing are model contracts, not measured silicon.

families.retirement_basis: The full comparison passed and adds no distinct assertion, mutation sequence or checkpoint shape. No separate regression was identified that requires its remaining value/checkpoint combinations. Those combinations are no longer claimed as covered; a newly evidenced interaction can justify a targeted regression.
